title: Kigali vs Nairobi: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: For first-time East Africa visitors seeking a cleaner, safer, and more organized experience with incredible gorilla trekking access, Kigali is your pick, budget around $80-150/day. faq.question: Which city is better for a solo female traveler?
faq.answer: Kigali is generally considered safer and more welcoming for solo female travelers due to its low crime rates and organized urban environment. Nairobi requires more vigilance, especially at night, but is manageable with common sense and ride-share apps like Uber/Bolt.

faq.question: What's the best way to travel between Kigali and Nairobi?
faq.answer: The most efficient way is by air. Direct flights are available from airlines like RwandAir, Kenya Airways, and Ethiopian Airlines, taking approximately 1 hour 30 minutes. One-way fares typically range from $150-$300, depending on booking time and airline.

faq.question: How many days should I spend in each city?
faq.answer: For Kigali, 2-3 days are sufficient to see the main sights like the Genocide Memorial and explore the city, plus an additional 2-3 days if you plan a gorilla trekking trip. For Nairobi, allow 3-5 days to cover Nairobi National Park, Sheldrick, Giraffe Centre, and explore the city's food and cultural scenes.

faq.question: Is it easy to get a visa for Rwanda and Kenya?
faq.answer: Both Rwanda and Kenya offer relatively straightforward visa processes. Many nationalities can obtain a visa on arrival or apply for an e-visa online before travel. Always check the latest requirements for your specific nationality before your trip.

faq.question: Which city has better internet connectivity?
faq.answer: Both cities offer good internet connectivity, especially in hotels, cafes, and coworking spaces. Kigali is particularly known for its excellent fiber optic infrastructure. Nairobi also has widespread and reliable 4G/5G mobile data and numerous Wi-Fi spots.

faq.question: Can I use US dollars in Kigali and Nairobi?
faq.answer: While major hotels and tour operators may accept USD, it's best to use local currency (Rwandan Francs in Kigali, Kenyan Shillings in Nairobi) for daily expenses. Exchange money at banks or forex bureaus, and ATMs are widely available in both cities.

faq.question: What's the best time of year to visit?
faq.answer: The long dry season (June to September) is ideal for both, offering comfortable weather and excellent wildlife viewing. The short dry season (December to February) is also good. Avoid the heavy rains of April-May if possible.

faq.question: Are there any health considerations for visiting?
faq.answer: Yes, both countries are malaria-risk areas, so consult your doctor about anti-malarial medication. Yellow fever vaccination is often required, especially if arriving from an endemic country. Ensure all routine vaccinations are up to date.
